notes.title: Full Controller support coming!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Thank you so much for waiting—starting with Ver.1.1.0, DigDigDrill can now be fully played with a controller![/p][p]From mining and moving to crafting drills, every action in the game can now be done with a controller alone.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991802/13b1101c213fc2ac0d8d29828900a2817cc2ef6c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991802/25d9d7eb9d0686c91f417af3e9935d6f7fe45630.png"][/img][/p][p] I’ve implemented support for various controllers such as PlayStation and Xbox, as well as key binding customization, so you can dig with your own comfortable setup![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991802/d5f9a9d6b25c716633c7cd4a0b1e6737f4b12a23.png"][/img][/p][p]
I’ll continue improving controller support in future updates, so I’d love to hear your feedback and requests.[/p][p]
Also, new content updates are in the works.[/p][p]They’ll take a little more time, but I hope you’ll look forward to them![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991802/69593f70880b9151093f3afc9a34889e9c4598fd.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: What’s Coming Next?
notes.notes:
[p]Hello!
Thank you so much for playing DigDigDrill![/p][p]To make the game even more enjoyable for those who’ve been digging deep, I'm working on adding new content and endgame challenges.[/p][p]
Here’s what’s coming in future updates:[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991802/72df57e74fc2d9754b4c728f208978fbef92a07f.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h3]<Improvements>[/h3][p][b]・Controller Support[/b]
One of the most requested features since release — controller support — is on the way!
I'm working to make the game comfortable to play with all major controllers, including the Steam Deck.[/p][p][b]
・Multi-Drill Forging[/b]
I know that repeatedly crafting drills just to get the effect you want (and watching the animation each time) isn’t the most exciting experience.
So I’m adding a feature that lets you forge multiple drills at once, based on your forging level.[/p][h3]
<New Content>[/h3][p][b]・Trial System[/b] 
For players who’ve beaten the Ruins, I’m planning a new “Trial” system that makes existing stages more challenging.  
Special conditions like “certain blocks become tougher” or “light range is reduced” will earn you powerful rewards if you clear them![/p][p][b]
・Expanding Equipment Choices[/b] 
Some Enchants fall out of use in the late game. 
 To make all effects valuable, I’m working on a new system to power them up — maybe a skill tree? A super move? Or effect evolution? Still in the works![/p][p][b] 
・New Uses for Coins & Gears
[/b]To make collecting items more fun, I’m adding new ways to spend your coins and gears!  [/p][hr][/hr][p]All of this will be added over time—stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: The Problem with the Charm Puzzle System and My Plan to Fix It
notes.notes:
Hello! 
I've noticed that the recently implemented Charm system isn't quite delivering the gameplay experience I aimed for. 
Specifically, in the puzzle system:
[list]
[*] Many accessories can't be fully set.
[*] Sometimes, the effect tiles can't be filled.
[*] To reduce Max Energy, you need to fill red tiles.
[/list]
To address these issues, I'm planning to adjust the puzzle mechanism while keeping the Charms themselves unchanged!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991802/868f5f3faf22deac6ff50b3a8196a962c3d51c08.png[/img]

I will keep updating DigDigDrill, so please look forward to it!

notes.title: Addressing "Max Energy Issue" and "Many Inspects Issue"!
notes.notes:
Hello.
Thank you so much for playing DigDigDrill!

In the upcoming major update, I’ll be addressing two significant issues:

[b]1. Max Energy Issue[/b]
Currently, once you increase the maximum energy capacity, you cannot decrease it.
This causes some Enchants to become less efficient as you upgrade.
To resolve this, I'm planning to add a feature that allows you to change your drill's frame. 
For example:
Decreasing bag size in exchange for higher critical chance
Lowering energy capacity to boost speed
By selecting frames that suit your drills, you’ll have more freedom to enjoy digging the way you like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991802/e11bafba8a216ff4660f21b2084b08737a3aaf63.png[/img]

[b]2. Many Inspects Issue[/b]
When exploring ruins, you often collect lots of Haniwas and Totems, but inspecting each one individually can be tedious.
I'll be introducing a feature to inspect multiple items at once, similar to large treasure chests.
This should make searching for Haniwas much smoother and more enjoyable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991802/361c62c07cafaa24b6be2ea66c5d64d68fbd222f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991802/9191adedf2bcc590f30ce465e956c7975f0d52ff.png[/img]

I hope you’re looking forward to these updates.
Happy digging!

notes.title: DigDigDrill Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello! The full version of DigDigDrill is finally released!
Dive into the world of digging and enjoy the pure fun of mining!

[h3][b]What’s next?[/b][/h3]
Here are some features planned for future updates:
*Controller support (including compatibility with Steam Deck)
*Adjustments to allow gameplay using only a mouse
*Addition of a skill tree and high-difficulty levels

[h3][b]How to transfer data from the demo version[/b][/h3]
When you open the full version, a “GetDemoData" button will appear in the top-right corner of the screen.
(If you accidentally started the full version from scratch, delete the full version's save data to make the "GetDemoData" button appear.)
